description: Repository guardrails. Review/trust via /hooks; never bypass trust.

hooks.command: node -e "try { const cp = require('node:child_process'); const p = require('node:path'); const u = require('node:url'); const root = cp.execFileSync('git', ['rev-parse', '--show-toplevel'], { encoding: 'utf8', windowsHide: true }).trim(); import(u.pathToFileURL(p.join(root, '.codex/hooks/pre-tool-use.mjs')).href).catch(() => process.exit(2)); } catch { process.exit(2); }"
